__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: The cluster Prometheus that scrapes Cantus Ultimus

title: Cantus Ultimus — Service health
description: Is the site working: availability, errors, latency, Solr, Celery and the pods.

panels.title: Site up
panels.description: Edge probe from outside the cluster: home page, manuscripts (Postgres) and search (Solr). Down if any target fails.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All requests Django handled.

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of responses that were 5xx, manifest proxy excluded (as in CantusHighErrorRate, which fires at 5%).

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile Django response time, manifest proxy excluded. CantusSlowResponses fires above 2s.

panels.title: Busy workers
panels.description: Requests in progress over gunicorn workers. CantusWorkersSaturated fires at 90% for 10 minutes.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Cantus Ultimus alerts firing now (routed to #cantus-ultimus-alerts).

panels.title: Running build
panels.description: Git commit of the app image the pods are running.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second, stacked by status class.

panels.title: 5xx by route
panels.description: Server errors per second by route and status. retrieve-manifest 502s are upstream libraries (see the usage dashboard).

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Django response time, manifest proxy excluded.

panels.title: p95 latency by route (slowest 10)
panels.description: Which routes are slow.

panels.title: Requests in progress vs workers
panels.description: Requests being handled right now against the number of sync gunicorn workers; at the line, new requests queue.

panels.title: DB queries per request (p95, by route)
panels.description: Database queries issued while handling one request; a jump means an N+1 query.

panels.title: Unhandled exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions that escaped a view (each was a 500 for the reader).

panels.title: Worker timeouts and exits
panels.description: Gunicorn workers aborted for exceeding the 600s timeout, and workers that exited for any reason.

panels.title: Probe result per target
panels.description: Blackbox probe every 60s. / is DNS, TLS, ingress, nginx, Django; manuscripts adds Postgres; search adds Solr.

panels.title: Probe duration per target
panels.description: Time for the full request from the blackbox exporter.

panels.title: Solr requests by operation and outcome
panels.description: Requests from the app, worker and exporter to Solr. rejected = Solr refused the query (bad search syntax).

panels.title: Solr p95 latency by operation
panels.description: Including client retries.

panels.title: Solr JVM heap
panels.description: Used against max. CantusSolrHeapHigh fires above 90% for 15 minutes.

panels.title: Sync sessions by outcome
panels.description: Batches of database changes pushed to Solr by the save/delete signals.

panels.title: Inventory collection errors
panels.description: Failed reads by the metrics exporter; short spikes during deploys are expected.

panels.title: celery queue
panels.description: Messages waiting (ready) and taken but not yet acknowledged (unacked).

panels.title: Task runs by task and outcome
panels.description: Celery task executions.

panels.title: Tasks in progress
panels.description: Tasks executing now (the worker runs one at a time).

panels.title: Task duration p95
panels.description: Execution time per task.

panels.title: Queue wait p95
panels.description: Time from publish to a worker starting the task.

panels.title: Oldest unfinished task
panels.description: Age of the oldest task result still queued or started. CantusCeleryTaskStuck fires above 6 hours.

panels.title: Consumers on celery
panels.description: Workers consuming the task queue. CantusCeleryNoConsumer fires at 0.

panels.title: RabbitMQ alarms
panels.description: Memory, disk and file-descriptor alarms; any alarm blocks publishers.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts in production pods; CantusPodRestarted fires on each.

panels.title: Memory used / limit
panels.description: Working set as a share of the memory limit. Above 90% for 15 minutes fires CantusMemoryNearLimit; at 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", pod!~".*staging.*", container!=""}) / on (pod, container) max by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="cantus-ultimus", resource="memory"})

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: CPU cores used.

panels.title: Volume free space
panels.description: Free share of each production volume; CantusVolumeFillingUp fires below 15%. Most are node disks shared with other workloads.

targets.expr: min by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", persistentvolumeclaim!~".*staging.*"}) / max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace="cantus-ultimus", persistentvolumeclaim!~".*staging.*"})
